name: Kemo Ane ~Kemomimi Onee-san o Oyome-san ni Shite Isekai Haramase Slow Life~
original_name: けもあね ～ケモ耳お姉さんをお嫁さんにして異世界孕ませスローライフ～
source:
Enjoy sweet healing from a busty animal-eared woman, and have child-bearing sex in this other world together!

After a hard life and death from overwork, the protagonist is reincarnated in another world, only to then be banished from his adventuring party.
But in his moment of need, a busty animal-eared woman named Lati is there to save him.
He is pampered, praised, and healed by her, and he even ends up impregnating her.
And so his toiling days change to a light and fluffy slow life~

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE264149.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
享受巨乳兽耳女的甜蜜治愈，一起在异世界生孩子！

经历了生死存亡后，主角转生到异世界，却被冒险队伍驱逐。
但就在他需要帮助的时候，一位名叫拉蒂的巨乳兽耳女人出现了，拯救了他。
他被她宠爱、赞美、治愈，甚至最终让她怀孕了。
于是他的辛苦日子就变成了轻松蓬松的慢生活~

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE264149.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
